import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=df, palette='viridis')

plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
